rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing diagram: a compact rectangular plate is subtracted to create a legible central void and a readable perimeter figure across all four views. The dominant gesture is clear and the parcel response is acceptable; the mass sits within the green boundary and the open figure is not merely leftover. The blue frontage/access edge is acknowledged through the visible cut/entry seam, so the public threshold is semantically aligned rather than sealed. However, the section is still too generic and box-derived relative to the neighborhood_living brief; the roofline and upper mass do not yet carry enough program-specific hierarchy or daylight/section logic. The silhouette reads more as a clipped box with a slot than as a capacity-bearing courtyard or terrace building, which lowers non_stair_silhouette and section_program_fit. No obvious view-to-view collisions appear, and repair integrity is strong.
